parameters.query:
WITH scope AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.chapter_title, c.page_number, c.book_id, c.embedding, b.title AS book_title
  FROM teachers_manager.book_chunks c
  JOIN teachers_manager.book_sources b ON b.id = c.book_id
  WHERE c.teacher_id = $1::uuid
    AND b.status = 'ready'
    AND (NULLIF($5, '') IS NULL OR c.book_id = NULLIF($5, '')::uuid)
    AND (
      NULLIF($2, '') IS NULL
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teachers_manager.book_student_links l WHERE l.book_id = b.id)
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teachers_manager.book_student_links l WHERE l.book_id = b.id AND l.student_id = NULLIF($2, '')::uuid)
    )
), page_hits AS (
  SELECT id, content, chapter_title, page_number, book_id, book_title, 0 AS grp, chunk_index::bigint AS ord
  FROM scope
  WHERE NULLIF($5, '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF($6, '') IS NOT NULL AND page_number = NULLIF($6, '')::integer
  ORDER BY chunk_index
  LIMIT 3
), sem AS (
  SELECT id, content, chapter_title, page_number, book_id, book_title, 1 AS grp,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY embedding <=> $3::vector) AS ord
  FROM scope
  ORDER BY embedding <=> $3::vector
  LIMIT $4::integer
)
SELECT * FROM page_hits
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM sem;
